quote: My heart is singing for joy this morning. A miracle has happened! The light of understanding has shone upon my little pupil’s mind, and behold, all things are changed!
source: Anne Sullivan, letter to Sophia C. Hopkins, 20 March 1887, in Helen Keller, The Story of My Life, Part III, ch. III (1903)

evidence.where: Project Gutenberg etext 2397 of The Story of My Life (Doubleday, Page, 1903), Part III, A Supplementary Account of Helen Keller's Life and Education, Chapter III, Education, the extract dated March 20, 1887; the chapter states the extracts are from Sullivan's letters to Mrs. Sophia C. Hopkins. Internet Archive scans of the 2003 restored edition carry the same text under MARCH 20, 1887.
evidence.edition: Helen Keller, The Story of My Life (Doubleday, Page and Company, 1903)
evidence.locator: Part III, Chapter III, Education, letter of 20 March 1887, opening sentences

reason: Read in the 1903 text word for word; the letter opens with these sentences. Sullivan is a distinct person from Keller, whose well-house line (11-fict-13) is also held for December, so the editor should not land both on the same morning of 1887. Not shipped, not at cap.
